interpretation: Observed labor-market wage/cost estimates and occupational duties are combined with explicit cost and task-time scenarios. These data do not observe completion time or acceptance on this study's tasks. No recruitment is required to reproduce this economic benchmark.
currency_policy: Calculate each benchmark in its source currency. The same numeric system-cost scenario in CAD, USD and EUR represents separate assumptions, not currency equivalence. No foreign-exchange conversion is used.
system_cost_status: ASSUMED_FULLY_ALLOCATED_RANGE; includes all model/compute/setup/verification/retry/maintenance/capability-construction allocation and employer attention. Unknown actual costs are not recorded as zero.
load_status: ASSUMED_MULTIPLIERS_ONLY; no uplift is added to published total-compensation or employer-cost series
